## Summary

**Mode derivation (announced):** `#4` is `agent::done` → **amends** mode. Built the delta envelope with `plan-context.js --amends 4` (planProfile `story-amendment`), which carried Story #4's prior body, acceptance, and delivered file map rather than re-interrogating the repo.

**Authored:** one cohesive Story (N=1 — the API unit plus the store schema it reads are a single deployable slice; default-single policy applies). I grounded `changes[]`/`verify[]` in the real code (`loadOwnedProject` is the shared ownership gate used by projects/tasks/exports; migrations are forward-only idempotent modules; API tests are contract tests via `_helpers`).

**Gates:**
- Critics (§2.5): consolidation + pre-mortem both `dispatch: false`, text-hygiene 0 findings → proceeded.
- Gate #1 & #2: auto-proceeded under runner-set `--yes` (headless).
- Dry-run: all hard gates green; tightened the Spec to clear the ~310→≤250-word soft advisory; re-dry-run clean.

**Persisted → Story [#9](https://github.com/dsj1984/bench-sbx-2026-07-25-epic-scope-mandrel-72e6c7d1/issues/9)** — `agent::ready`, label `plan-run::898cfded`.

**Key design decisions folded into the Spec** (the amendment's contract):
- New migration `002_project_shares.js`: `project_shares(projectId, userId, role)`, cascading FKs, `UNIQUE(projectId,userId)`, `role` CHECK ∈ {viewer, editor}.
- A capability ladder (owner > editor > viewer > none) centralized in the projects handler; `loadOwnedProject` kept for owner-only paths, plus an access loader for required-capability reads/writes.
- **Privacy invariant preserved:** no relationship → 404 everywhere; a shared user lacking write capability → 403 (they can already see the project).
- `POST /projects/:id/shares`: owner-only (else 404), 201 upsert, 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` for unknown user / bad role / missing fields.
- Confined to the API + store schema: worker (Unit 3) and admin CLI (Unit 4) untouched; exports stay owner-only (explicit non-goal).

**Note on `supersedes`:** I did **not** pass `--source-tickets 4` / supersede #4. #4 shipped a different, already-delivered feature (the admin CLI); closing it as superseded would misrepresent shipped history. The amends *envelope* served its purpose as a planning input. If you intended the shipped #4 to actually be closed/replaced by this Story, tell me and I can re-persist with the supersede link.

Next step (not run): `/deliver 9`.

Story #9 has **landed**. The earlier empty outputs were a redirect/pipe artifact; this run shows the full close chain completing cleanly.

## Delivery complete — Story #9 landed via PR #10

**Discovery:** The planning pipeline authored a single Story-only ticket (the v2 model has no `type::epic`) — **#9** "Project sharing via POST /projects/:id/shares", `plan-run::898cfded`, `agent::ready`. I delivered the existing plan unchanged (no re-planning).

**Terminal envelope:**
```json
{"status":"landed","phase":"post-land","pr":{"number":10,"state":"MERGED","checksStatus":"success"},
 "gates":{"validation":"passed","baseSync":"passed","codeReview":"passed"}}
```

**What shipped** (one branch `story-9` → PR #10 → squash-merged to `main`, `agent::done`):
- **Migration `002_project_shares.js`** — `project_shares(projectId, userId, role)`, both FKs `ON DELETE CASCADE`, `UNIQUE(projectId, userId)`, `role` `CHECK`-constrained to `viewer|editor`; runner stays idempotent.
- **`projects.js`** — centralized capability ladder (owner > editor > viewer > none). Kept `loadOwnedProject` for owner-only paths; added `loadProjectAtCapability` (no relationship → 404, too-weak relationship → 403). `GET /projects` now UNIONs shared projects; `createShare` is owner-only with an idempotent upsert and 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` on missing/blank/unknown `userId` or bad `role`.
- **`tasks.js`** — reads require viewer-or-above, writes require editor-or-above.
- **`router.js`** — added `POST /projects/:id/shares`; **`errors.js`** — added `forbidden` (403).
- **Tests** — new `shares.test.js` contract suite (all 5 ACs) + `project_shares` schema coverage.

**Verification:** full `npm test` green (68 pass); close-validation (typecheck/lint/format), base-sync, and 3-lens code review (0 findings) all passed.

**Scope honored:** worker (Unit 3) and admin CLI (Unit 4) untouched; no revoke/list-shares, no export widening, deletion/re-sharing stay owner-only.
